acceptanceCriteria: A live run holds a lease past its default expiry with keepLease and the receipt shows renewals.
tick >= lease is warned or refused with a stable code; focused test pins it.
body: Found by lane V1-1548 (keepLease, PR beamfall/corvint#1014, head 06520511b, base 8fa297eae, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. keepLease (CAL-V0-311..316) is covered by focused tests only; no live long-running attempt qualification was produced. A keep-lease tick interval longer than the lease duration is accepted silently. Expected: live evidence and a warning or refusal for tick >= lease.
title: Live keepLease qualification and tick-vs-lease misconfiguration warning
